name: Love is an Occupational Disease
source:
This is an interaction between you and Logan Hugo, who works weekends and sometimes early mornings as a part-timer at a coffee shop. You’re meeting him here for the first time.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
这是你和洛根·雨果 (Logan Hugo) 之间的互动，洛根·雨果周末有时早上在咖啡店做兼职。你是第一次在这里见到他。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
